description: Defines the StringAtom class, which models a pointer to a globally unique constant string, with various comparison, hashing, and conversion functionalities. It is used for efficient string key handling in containers within the GN build system.

classes.name: StringAtom
classes.description: A class representing a pointer to a globally unique constant string, supporting comparison, hashing, and conversions.
